name: lanes-guards
description: Multi-session guards for a lead and its lanes: only the lead dispatches CI, merges and pushes anything but one named non-default branch; only the lead sends plan messages; no edits in the main checkout. For destructive commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard) use destructive_command_guard or cc-safety-net; this plugin does not cover them.

lead_only_commands.title: Lead-only commands
lead_only_commands.description: Commands only the lead session may run, separated by semicolons. A project's .lanes/guards.md overrides this. git push @default means every push except git push <remote> <one non-default branch>.
lead_only_commands.default: gh workflow run; gh pr merge; git push @default

plan_marker.title: Plan marker
plan_marker.description: A SendMessage whose text starts with this marker is refused unless the sender is the lead. A project's .lanes/guards.md overrides this.

main_checkout_guard.title: Main-checkout guard
main_checkout_guard.description: Refuse Edit, Write and NotebookEdit inside the main checkout while linked worktrees exist. A project's .lanes/guards.md overrides this.

lead_exempt_main_checkout.title: Lead may edit the main checkout
lead_exempt_main_checkout.description: Let the lead session edit the main checkout when the main-checkout guard is on. A project's .lanes/guards.md overrides this.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch a lane may never name in its explicit git push. Empty means the remote's head, else main and master. A project's .lanes/guards.md overrides this.
